title: Pocket Planet
tagline: Nudge a tiny world through its first, very small sunrise.
description: Spin a hand-sized planet and guide drifting seeds into the right climate bands. There is no wrong way to leave it; the satisfying part is finding a gentle rhythm between gravity, water, and the next orbit.
prompt: Build a self-contained browser game called Pocket Planet. Spin a hand-sized planet and guide drifting seeds into the right climate bands. There is no wrong way to leave it; the satisfying part is finding a gentle rhythm between gravity, water, and the next orbit.
